d: Three players, three forfeits and one big question for the chess authorities. Magnus Carlsen, Abhimanyu Mishra and Richard Rapport all chose not to play their final fast-classical games after their respective matches had already been decided. The controversy has put FIDE, tournament regulations and the idea of sporting responsibility under the spotlight. Carlsen has not broken the rules, but his decision has exposed a gap between what the regulations permit and what organisers expect from players. So should chess punish players for taking advantage of the system, or fix the system itself?…
